name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ExposedRoot.basis_change_preimage
title: Exposed-row basis change is exact: for invertible W, A D = Y iff (W A) D = W Y, so GGH15 preimages may be sampled in the basis [exposed rows; complement]
statement: For a left-invertible square matrix W (Winv * W = 1) over a ring, A * D = Y holds iff (W * A) * D = W * Y.
